Broad Occupation Category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
Major Group: Professional occupations in natural and applied science
Sub-Major Group: Professional occupations in physical and life sciences
Unit Group Description: Food scientists and technologists conduct research and studies on the chemical, physical, nutritional and biological characteristics of food. They develop new food products and processes, and oversee the production of food products.

Dietitians and nutritionists plan, implement and oversee nutrition programs. They provide consulting services and advice on nutrition and food preparation to individuals, institutions and commercial enterprises.

Broad Occupation Category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
Major Group: Professional occupations in natural and applied science
Sub-Major Group: Professional occupations in physical and life sciences
Unit Group Description: Foresters manage and develop forest lands and their resources for conservation, recreational, commercial and other purposes. They are employed by federal and provincial governments, consulting companies, forest industries and other establishments.

Broad Occupation Category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
Major Group: Technical occupations related to natural and applied sciences
Minor Group: Chemical and geological technologists and technicians
Unit Group Description: Forestry technologists and technicians provide technical support to forestry research, forest management and forest harvesting activities. They are employed by federal and provincial governments, consulting companies, forest industries and other establishments.

Pharmacists dispense prescription medications to patients and offer expertise in the safe use of prescriptions. They also may conduct health and wellness screenings, provide immunizations, oversee the medications given to patients, and provide advice on healthy lifestyles.

Medical laboratory technologists conduct medical laboratory tests, experiments and analyses to assist in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of disease. They are employed in medical laboratories in hospitals, clinics, research facilities, and other healthcare facilities.

Broad Occupation Category: Occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Major Group: Professional occupations in art and culture
Unit Group Description: Librarians select, develop, organize and maintain library collections and provide advisory services for users. They are employed in libraries or other establishments with library services throughout the public and private sectors.

Broad Occupation Category: Occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Major Group: Professional occupations in art and culture
Sub-Major Group: Writing translating and related communications professionals
Unit Group Description: Authors and writers plan, research and write books, scripts, storyboards, plays, essays, speeches, manuals, specifications and other non-journalistic articles for publication or presentation. They are employed by advertising agencies, governments, large corporations, private consulting firms, publishing firms, multimedia/new-media companies or they may be self-employed.

Broad Occupation Category: Occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Major Group: Professional occupations in art and culture
Sub-Major Group: Writing translating and related communications professionals
Unit Group Description: Journalists research, investigate, interpret and communicate news and public affairs through newspapers, television, radio and other media. They are employed by radio and television networks and stations, newspapers and magazines.

Broad Occupation Category: Occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Major Group: Technical occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Sub-Major Group: Technical occupations in motion pictures broadcasting and the performing arts
Minor Group: Technical and coordinating occupations in motion pictures broadcasting and the performing arts
Unit Group Description: Audio and video recording technicians operate and maintain equipment used to record, edit and reproduce sound and images for radio and television programs, motion pictures, music recordings, live performances and video productions.

Physiotherapists assess patients and plan and carry out individually designed treatment programs to maintain, improve or restore physical functioning, alleviate pain and prevent physical dysfunction in patients.

Broad Occupation Category: Occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Major Group: Support occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Sub-Major Group: Support occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Minor Group: Support occupations in art culture recreation and sport
Unit Group Occupation: Program Leaders and Instructors in Recreation Sport and Fitness
Unit Group Description: Program leaders and instructors in recreation, sport and fitness lead and instruct individuals and groups in recreational, sports, fitness and related activities. They are employed by municipal recreation departments, community centres, health and fitness clubs, camps, and other recreational facilities.

Broad Occupation Category: Occupations in social science education government service and religion
Major Group: Professional occupations in law and social community and government services
Sub-Major Group: Judges lawyers Quebec notaries and related occupations
Unit Group Description: Lawyers and Quebec notaries advise clients on legal matters, represent clients before tribunals and judicial bodies and act for clients in various legal transactions. Quebec notaries advise clients in non-contentious legal matters and draft legal documents.

Broad Occupation Category: Occupations in social science education government service and religion
Major Group: Paraprofessional occupations in legal social services education and religion
Sub-Major Group: Paraprofessional occupations in legal and public protection services
Unit Group Description: Paralegal and related occupations assist lawyers and Quebec notaries in providing legal services to clients. They are employed in law firms, record search companies, insurance companies, real estate companies, municipal, provincial and federal courts and government departments and agencies.

Broad Occupation Category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
Major Group: Professional occupations in natural and applied science
Sub-Major Group: Professional occupations in applied sciences (except engineering)
Unit Group Description: Mathematicians and statisticians research mathematical or statistical theories, and develop and apply mathematical or statistical techniques for solving problems in such fields as science, engineering, business and social science. Actuaries apply mathematics, statistics, probability and risk theory to assess potential financial impacts of future events.

Broad Occupation Category: Natural and applied sciences and related occupations
Major Group: Professional occupations in natural and applied science
Sub-Major Group: Professional occupations in applied sciences (except engineering)
Unit Group Description: Data scientists use advanced analytics technologies, including machine learning and predictive modeling, to support the identification of trends and patterns in complex data sets. They clean, analyze and interpret large amounts of data to identify ways to help a business improve processes and gain a competitive advantage.
